title: Reorder flags with IF
summary: Flag shoe lines that have fallen to their reorder point, so the replenishment list builds itself.

blocks.text: The Nakuru branch manager sends the stock count every Monday. Your job is to mark which lines need a reorder before the supplier cut-off at noon.

Each line has stock on hand and a reorder point. When stock is at or below the reorder point, the line needs a reorder. IF turns that rule into a formula, so the flags update as soon as the count changes.

items: Objective: use IF with a comparison to flag a business threshold.
You pass the mission at 75% or more in the Assessment.

blocks.text: IF tests a condition that is TRUE or FALSE, then returns the first value when it is TRUE and the second when it is FALSE.
If on hand (B2) is at or below the reorder point (C2), show Reorder; otherwise show OK. Text results need double quotes.
Watch the boundary. "At or below" is <=, not <. With 30 pairs on hand and a reorder point of 30, the line must be reordered.
Refer to the threshold cell (C2) instead of typing 25 into the formula. When the buyer changes a reorder point, every flag follows.
Four questions on IF and thresholds. Type numbers without commas or currency, for example 360.

items: IF has three parts: a condition, the value if TRUE and the value if FALSE.
Choose the operator from the business rule: "at or below" is <=, "at least" is >=.
Text results need double quotes; numbers do not.
Point at threshold cells instead of typing numbers, so the rule follows the data.

blocks.text: Next: XLOOKUP, to pull prices from a product list instead of typing them.

items.prompt: Ankle boots: 30 pairs on hand (B4), reorder point 30 (C4). What does =IF(B4<=C4,"Reorder","OK") show?
A store earns a "Bonus" when weekly sales in B2 are at least KES 50,000; otherwise the cell stays empty. Which formula is correct?
A sales associate sold KES 7,200 of shoes (B2). What does =IF(B2>=5000,B2*5%,0) return, in KES?
Why write =IF(B2<=C2,"Reorder","OK") instead of =IF(B2<=25,"Reorder","OK") when C2 holds 25?
